{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABYK40Ow", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhBt_68", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 82, "title": "Switch bundled Examples and physics validation to WebAssembly Ammo.js", "body": "## Problem

The repository's public Examples, Worker Physics, and primary physics tests currently use the **JavaScript/asm.js** build of `ammojs-typed@1.1.0`, not the WebAssembly build:

- [`examples/webgl_loader_mmd.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/webgl_loader_mmd.html#L18) and the other Example pages load `node_modules/ammojs-typed/ammo/ammo.js`.
- [`examples/scene.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts) initializes that global Ammo runtime and passes the asm.js URL to Worker Physics.
- [`src/animation/MMDPhysicsWorker.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysicsWorker.ts) uses `importScripts(ammoURL)` and awaits the Ammo factory.
- [`scripts/build-examples.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/scripts/build-examples.ts) currently copies only `ammo/ammo.js`, and browser tests also reference the same script.

The **same pinned package** already includes `ammo/ammo.wasm.js` and `ammo/ammo.wasm.wasm`, exposed as `ammojs-typed/wasm` for module imports ([package manifest](https://github.com/giniedp/ammojs-typed/blob/master/package.json)). We want to try this bundled WASM build **without upgrading Bullet, changing the physics model/solver settings, or creating a custom Ammo.js fork yet**.

This is an engine-implementation/performance experiment, not evidence that WASM improves stability, MMD fidelity, or performance in every environment.

## Expected outcome

Use the **WebAssembly Ammo.js build from existing `ammojs-typed@1.1.0` as the default runtime in the repository's shipped public Examples and their Worker Physics demo**, and exercise WASM in the project's real physics validation (sync and Worker). Preserve the public library contract: `MMDPhysics` continues to accept a caller-initialized compatible `globalThis.Ammo`, and Worker mode continues to accept `workerPhysics.ammoURL`; consumers are not forced to use the repository's bundled choice.

Handle loading of the *separate* `.wasm` binary explicitly, including asynchronous factory initialization and reliable WASM binary resolution in the main thread and **classic Worker**. Avoid silently continuing with asm.js while claiming to use WASM. Preserve a practical failure diagnostic and the existing Worker→Sync fallback behavior rather than leaving an uninitialized runtime.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replace the default Examples' asm.js script path with the pinned `ammo.wasm.js` glue, initialize it asynchronously **before** creating physics, and make sure the `ammo.wasm.wasm` file is found using the correct base URL/`locateFile` strategy in the page and Worker. Validate the actual `WebAssembly` backend was instantiated; a successful `Ammo()` call alone is not enough evidence.
- [ ] Update Worker Physics `ammoURL` in Examples to the WASM glue and ensure the existing **classic Worker**, `importScripts`, SAB and transferable transport paths all work. A relative WASM lookup must not accidentally resolve relative to `MMDPhysicsWorker.js` or the page rather than the glue/binary location. Check initialization failure/timeout diagnostics and synchronous fallback under missing or invalid WASM resources.
- [ ] Update `scripts/build-examples.ts` and any applicable local-server, publishing manifest, Pages backup/rollback, asset verification, and license-notice paths so **both** `ammo.wasm.js` and `ammo.wasm.wasm` are packaged and served on the same origin under the Pages project path, with appropriate `application/wasm` handling where needed. No requests to unavailable external CDNs.
- [ ] Move the relevant real-Ammo physics test baseline to WASM (or explicitly distinguish and retain a small asm.js comparison baseline where useful). Update any unit/browser harnesses that import the default `ammojs-typed` or hardcode `ammo.js` so that tests claimed to validate WASM genuinely do so. Cover PMD and PMX, standalone sync, shared sync, Worker-owned worlds, both transports, constraints, type-2 bones, warmup/reset, and existing Worker fallback where applicable.
- [ ] Check numerical motion/timekeeping regressions with real Ammo trajectories, accounting for reasonable floating-point tolerance but **not** weakening tests merely to hide backend differences. Separately report significant changes in solver outcomes, including any compatibility concerns.
- [ ] Capture reproducible **before/after** baseline performance observations where feasible (initialization latency, bundle/binary transfer sizes and representative physics stepping cost), using the same machine/workload for asm.js vs WASM. Do not assume WASM is automatically faster or assert improvements without measurement.
- [ ] Preserve existing physics behavior and parameters: `unitStep = 1/60`, `maxStepNum = 10`, YXZ rigid-body/joint Euler order, damping, collisions, `STOP_ERP = 0.475`, mode-2 sync, IK/grants, gravity, animation scheduling, reset/warmup and Worker coalescing. **Do not simultaneously update Bullet or `ammojs-typed` version, rewrite physics logic, or introduce new solver tuning.**
- [ ] Document how consumers can initialize the supported Ammo WebAssembly build (including serving the binary and worker URL/CSP requirements), while explaining that compatible caller-provided Ammo builds remain supported. Note browser WebAssembly availability and any operational or initialization trade-offs.
- [ ] Run and accurately report `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, `npm run build:examples`, `MMD_EXAMPLE_SITE=dist/examples npm run test:examples`, `npm pack --dry-run` where applicable, and `git diff --check`. Verify the **built** Examples locally at the actual Pages project path. Report any skipped/unavailable checks as such.
- [ ] **Do not require merge-triggered GitHub Pages publication or the maintainer's subjective real-model/visual evaluation as pre-merge PR approval or merge criteria.**

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until merged:** Inspect the **latest attempt** of the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow, record its URL, final result, deployed merge SHA/date, and ensure both WASM artifacts plus the newly published site content are present. Do not call this passing before it happens. If the initial attempt fails with transient HTTP 503 or browser timeout, inspect the subsequent attempt and actual final status.
- **PENDING until merged:** Check the public PMD, Worker Physics, and Gene Light PMX Examples in actual browsers. Confirm that the separate WASM binary loads and the runtime really executes WASM, assets and animations load without runtime errors, Worker stays in Worker mode in supported configurations, and basic controlled physics updates run successfully. Record browser/transport, URL and evidence; distinguish this from long-running natural-playback verification.
- **Optional maintainer follow-up (not a merge blocker):** Evaluate appearance, real-model physics and sustained stability, and decide whether to retain/revert the WASM default. Neither CI nor successful Pages publication establishes MMD motion parity or resolves previously reported violent oscillation.

## Context

- The repository already uses `ammojs-typed@1.1.0` as a pinned development dependency and documents consumer-supplied Ammo initialization in the [README](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/README.md). The package supplies the WASM build without a dependency change: [`ammojs-typed` manifest](https://github.com/giniedp/ammojs-typed/blob/master/package.json).
- [Current main-thread Example initialization and Worker URL](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts), [Worker initialization](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysicsWorker.ts), [published Examples build](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/scripts/build-examples.ts).
- Previous isolated physics changes, including [joint YXZ Issue #80 / PR #81](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/81), must remain intact. A potential **newer Bullet** or custom WASM build is a **separate future experiment**, not part of this issue.
